units.source_text: 到达二条院时，天色已黑。

en.t: By the time they reached the Nijo estate, the sky had already grown dark.

units.source_text: 车子赶近殿前，那些乡村里出来的侍女们，看见灯烛辉煌，繁华热闹，气象迥异他处，觉得到这里来当差有些不惯呢。

en.t: As the carriage drew near the front of the residence, the women attendants who had come from the countryside saw the brilliant lamplight and lively splendor, so unlike anywhere else, and felt that serving here would take some getting used to.

units.source_text: 源氏公子派定向西的一间为小女公子的居室，内有特殊设备，小型的器具布置得异常美观。

en.t: Prince Genji assigned a west-facing room as the little princess's chamber; it had special furnishings, and the small articles were arranged with exceptional beauty.

units.source_text: 西边廊房靠北的一间，是乳母的居室。

en.t: A room on the north side of the western corridor was set aside as the nurse's chamber.

units.source_text: 小女公子在途中睡着了。

en.t: The little princess had fallen asleep on the way.
When she was lifted down from the carriage, she did not cry.

units.source_text: 侍女们带她到紫夫人房中，给她吃些饼饵。

en.t: The attendants took her to Lady Murasaki's room and gave her some cakes to eat.

units.source_text: 她渐渐发觉四周景象不同，又不见了母亲，便向各处寻找，脸上显出要哭的模样。

en.t: Gradually she realized that everything around her was different, and when she could no longer see her mother, she began looking everywhere, her face showing that she was about to cry.

units.source_text: 紫夫人便喊乳母过来安慰她。

en.t: Lady Murasaki then called the nurse over to comfort her.
